name: iBabs agendapunten to decidesk AgendaItems
description: Reads agendapunten for a vergadering from the iBabs RIS source and writes them into decidesk's AgendaItem OpenRegister objects. {{vergaderingId}} is supplied per run; targetId is decidesk's register/schema id pair (fill in per instance: <decideskRegisterId>/<agendaItemSchemaId>).
